subject: Urgent: service debt settlement discussion — Connect API latency & errors
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@cloudory.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: sustained latency/errors impacting Connect API — credit request & exec triage

Soojin,

We're experiencing a prolonged degradation on the Connect API that started late Friday and continues into this morning. Our telemetry shows the 95th percentile latency has been elevated (~2.1s vs baseline 450ms) and error rates spiked to 6.2% on many production routes between 02:00 and 07:30 UTC. This is impacting real-time features for our customers and triggering failover logic on our side.

We've attached a small sample set of request/response traces and timestamps (performance-samples.zip). We need three things immediately: a concise acknowledgement, an estimated SLA credit (per section 4 of the SOW) as a starting point for negotiations, and an executive-level call within 24 hours to align on root cause and remediation cadence.

Given the sustained nature of the issue, our leadership is requesting a written settlement path that addresses credits and a short-term contract amendment to guarantee retry/prefetch safeguards until you push the runtime fix. Please let me know availability for a 30–45 minute exec sync.

Thanks,
Daniel
Ops Lead — Cloudory
On Mon, Jul 19, 2027 at 10:05 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@cloudory.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: sustained latency/errors impacting Connect API — credit request & exec triage

Hi Daniel — thank you for the signal and the trace bundle. I’m very sorry for the disruption Cloudory is seeing. We take sustained latency and error spikes seriously and will prioritize a fast plan to make this right.

Action items from our side: 1) I’m scheduling an executive triage call (members: myself, Marcus, Rachel, and Head of Legal) — proposed windows this afternoon and tomorrow morning; 2) Marcus will validate traces and produce an initial SLA-credit estimate (spreadsheet); 3) Laura will standby for contract amendment language and quick review of any credit wording.

Can you confirm availability for a 30-minute call today at 4:00 PM PT or tomorrow at 9:00 AM PT? I’ll also share a short one-pager with our proposed credit calculation before the call.

Again — apologies from the Redwood team. We’ll move quickly.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
On Mon, Jul 19, 2027 at 09:12 AM Daniel Park <daniel.park@cloudory.com> wrote:
> (original message above)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: sustained latency/errors impacting Connect API — credit request & exec triage

Soojin / team — digging into the samples now. Preliminary notes: the traces show increased queueing on the request path that looks consistent with a batching policy regression introduced in the runtime earlier this month (we rolled a batching optimization on 2027-07-05). That aligns with increased tail latency and some timeouts that manifest as client-visible errors.

For credit math, I'm using the SOW SLA table (section 4.2) and the documented "service debt" approach we used in prior incidents: 1) quantify impacted tokens/requests window; 2) map to per-request unit cost; 3) calculate proportional credit for the billing period; 4) apply a discretionary uplift for operational impact. I attached a working calc: sla-credit-calculation.xlsx.

Estimated ballpark before legal review: 10–18% of the invoice for the impacted month depending on whether we include the discretionary uplift. I recommend we present a firm proposal at the exec call with a clear timeline for the runtime rollback/patch and a temporary routing policy to limit exposure while the fix is staged.

I’ll push a short slide (postmortem-draft.pdf) summarizing suspected root cause, mitigations, and a proposed two-week fix-and-validate timeline.

—Marcus
Principal SRE | Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@cloudory.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: sustained latency/errors impacting Connect API — credit request & exec triage

Marcus / Soojin — thanks for the quick triage. From a commercial perspective Cloudory is a net-new ARR expansion (Q3 renewal window approaching) and we should be conservative but fair. Proposal for the call: present a draft settlement that includes a 15% credit on the impacted month, plus a commitment to the two-week mitigation plan Marcus described, with a waived amendment fee for adding the temporary retry/prefetch clause. If Legal signs off, we can route the agreement through DocuSign and apply the credit to next invoice cycle.

Linked HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/CLD-8342 — I can draft the quote and DocuSign envelope if we agree.

Soojin — happy to take the lead on the commercial wording during the exec call.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@cloudory.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: sustained latency/errors impacting Connect API — credit request & exec triage

Team — thanks for the quick work here and for the transparent approach. Cloudory can accept the proposed settlement path: 15% credit for the impacted month, immediate scheduling of the exec triage (we're good for Jul 22 at 9:30 AM PT), and a short contract amendment to add temporary retry/prefetch language until your runtime patch is in production.

Please send the DocuSign and the credit calculation before EOD tomorrow so our finance/legal can review. Also confirm the expected timeline for the patch rollout and any temporary config changes we should apply on our side to reduce visible errors.

Appreciate the partnership on this — Daniel
Ops Lead — Cloudory
